name: Advanced Age Verification Popup
author: Yeasin

sections.description:
Advanced Age Verification Popup adds a clean, modern age gate to your website in minutes. It is built for shops and sites that sell or show age-restricted content — vape and e-cigarette shops, wine and spirits stores, CBD shops and adult content sites.

A setup wizard walks you through the essentials, a live preview shows every change before you save, and the popup works with every page cache out of the box.

Free features

  • Yes / No buttons, date of birth or both — the date-of-birth check uses separate Day / Month / Year fields in the visitor’s own order and language, with the native scroll wheel on phones.
  • Any minimum age — 18, 21 or any number you need.
  • Setup wizard and live preview — get set up in under two minutes and see the popup before you save.
  • Test mode — only administrators see the gate while you set it up.
  • Cache friendly — works with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, Cloudflare and server caching.
  • SEO friendly — search engine crawlers such as Googlebot and Bingbot skip the popup so your pages stay indexed.
  • Colour styles — five ready-made styles, a “Your theme” style made from your theme’s colours (block themes, classic themes with an editor palette, and Astra), or your own colours, plus your logo and texts.
  • Your website’s font — the popup can use the font of your theme, so it matches your site. Nothing is downloaded.
  • “Remember me” — visitors choose between the full cookie duration or a single browser session.
  • Skip for logged-in users — members and customers who are logged in are not asked again.
  • Links in the popup — link to your terms or privacy policy from the subtitle or warning line with one click, so visitors can read what they agree to. Linked pages open in a new tab and never show the popup.
  • Under-age page — send visitors who are too young to one of your own pages or any address.
  • Pages without the popup — keep your privacy policy, terms or contact page open (from the settings screen or the editor of any post, page or product).
  • Verification counter and Reports page — see how many visitors passed or were turned away in the last 30 days, with a daily chart, plus a small “this week” widget on your WordPress dashboard.
  • One-click “Sorry” page — create a friendly page for under-age visitors with one click; it is kept free of the popup automatically.
  • Multilingual — WPML and Polylang support for all popup texts; translation ready.
  • Accessible — keyboard friendly dialog with focus handling and screen reader labels.
  • Show the popup only on some pages — only on paths such as /shop/*, or everywhere except them.
  • Schedule — turn the gate on between two dates.
  • WooCommerce “My Account” tab — customers see their verification status and can verify from their account.
  • Maximum age — rejects fake birth years such as 1900 in the date-of-birth check.
  • Corner radius — set the roundness of the popup and its buttons.
  • Weekly email report — optional Monday email with the week’s verification totals.
  • Cookie name and path — for developers and agencies.
  • Lightweight — no external requests and no heavy libraries.

Pro version

Advanced Age Verification Pro is a separate, paid plugin for stores that need stronger compliance tools, such as ID checks with a provider, rules per country, date-of-birth checks at WooCommerce checkout and audit logs. This free plugin does not contain any Pro features. If you switch to Pro, your free settings carry over automatically. The settings screen follows the layout of Pro: each section shows what this plugin offers, and a short description of what Pro adds. The “Free vs Pro” page lists the differences.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New (search for “Advanced Age Verification Popup”) or upload the zip file.
  2. Activate it. The setup wizard opens on the Age Verification screen in your admin menu.
  3. Choose the minimum age, the verification method, a colour style and your texts.
  4. Turn off test mode when you are ready and clear your page cache.
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The popup works on every page, including the shop, cart and checkout, and you can add an “Age Verification” tab to My Account where customers see their status. The Pro version can limit the gate to certain products or categories and check the date of birth at checkout.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The visitor’s verification is checked in the browser, so cached pages work correctly with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, Cloudflare and others. After changing the popup, clear your page cache once.

Will the popup hurt my SEO?

No. Search engine crawlers skip the popup when “Let search engines crawl without the popup” is on (default).

Can I set the age to 21?

Yes. Set any minimum age on the General tab or in the setup wizard.

How do I see the popup while I am logged in?

Click Preview at the top of the settings screen, or turn on test mode — administrators always see the gate in test mode.

Does the plugin store personal data or contact external services?

No. The plugin stores a small cookie (age_verified by default; you can rename it under Advanced & Tools) in the visitor’s browser to remember the answer. It does not store a date of birth and makes no requests to external services. If you turn on the optional weekly email report, it is sent by your own site through WordPress email (wp_mail) to the addresses you choose. The optional verification counter only stores daily totals (how many visitors passed and how many were turned away) in your own database. To stop the same device being counted again and again, a salted hash of the visitor’s IP address is kept for one day in a temporary record and then deleted automatically; the IP address itself is never stored. You can turn the counter off under Behaviour → Count verifications. Links to the documentation, the support forum, WordPress.org reviews and the Pro version are plain links you can choose to open; nothing is loaded from them until you click.

Can I keep some pages free of the popup?

Yes. Tick them under Behaviour → Pages without the popup, or use the “Age verification” box in the editor of any post, page or product. These pages stay open after an upgrade to Pro too.

Can I link to my terms or privacy policy in the popup?

Yes. On the Popup content tab, use the “+ Terms link”, “+ Privacy link” or “+ Custom link” buttons under the subtitle or warning line, or type {terms} or {privacy} in the text. {terms} links to your WooCommerce terms page or a page with a slug such as “terms-and-conditions”; {privacy} links to the privacy policy page set in Settings → Privacy. To change the link text, write {terms|Read our terms}. Simple HTML links such as <a href="https://example.com/terms/">our terms</a> work too. Linked pages open in a new tab and never show the popup.

Will my settings be kept if I upgrade to Pro?

Yes. Pro uses the same settings, so your popup keeps working without any setup. If you later delete the free plugin while Pro is installed, your settings are kept.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. The plugin uses the text domain advanced-age-verification-popup, and the popup texts you enter can be translated with WPML or Polylang.
sections.changelog:
1.4.1

  • New: The settings screen follows the layout of Advanced Age Verification Pro (Verification & Rules, WooCommerce, Geo-Location, Design & Themes, Security & Lockout, Schedule, Integrations, Rules & Compatibility, Advanced & Tools). Each section shows the settings of this plugin first and a short description of what Pro adds below them.
  • New: Show the popup only on some paths, or everywhere except them (Rules & Compatibility).
  • New: Schedule the gate between two dates (Schedule & A/B Test).
  • New: “Age Verification” tab in WooCommerce My Account, with the customer’s status and a “Verify Age Now” button.
  • New: Maximum age for the date-of-birth check (Security & Lockout).
  • New: Corner radius of the popup and its buttons (Design & Themes).
  • New: Typography → “Your website’s font” (Design & Themes). New installs use it by default; existing sites keep their current font.
  • New: “Your theme” colour style, made from the colours of your theme. Click it to try it in the preview; nothing changes until you save.
  • New: Optional weekly email report with the verification totals (Integrations & Access).
  • New: Custom cookie name and path (Advanced & Tools).
  • New: Reports page with the verification counter for the last 30 days, and an “Upgrade to Pro” link in the plugin menu.
  • Tweak: The read-only previews of Pro screens were removed. All new settings use the same names as Pro, so they carry over after an upgrade. If this site used Pro before, the values Pro saved for these settings are used again.
  • Tweak: The popup’s script and styles now include the file date in their version, so browsers and CDNs load the new files after an update.
  • Security: The verification counter can no longer be inflated by repeated requests from the same address.
  • Tweak: Updated translation template (.pot) with every text of the plugin.

1.4.0

  • New: Read-only previews of every Advanced Age Verification Pro screen (Verification & Rules, Geo-Location, WooCommerce, Design & Themes, Security & Lockout, Schedule & A/B Test, Integrations & Access, Rules & Compatibility, Advanced & Tools, Compliance Logs, Analytics and Identity Requests) in the settings sidebar. Nothing in a preview is saved or run.
  • New: A complete Free vs Pro comparison with a “Preview the settings” link for each Pro feature.
  • Tweak: The Pro verification methods on the General tab now open their settings preview.
  • Tweak: Removed the large Pro banner and the tour video link from the top of the settings screen, so your settings come first.

1.3.1

  • New: Links in the popup subtitle and warning line, for example to your terms and conditions or privacy policy.
  • New: “+ Terms link”, “+ Privacy link” and “+ Custom link” buttons under the popup texts.
  • New: Smart links {terms} and {privacy} find your terms and privacy pages automatically; {terms|Your text} sets the link text.
  • New: Pages linked from the popup never show the popup, so visitors can read them before they agree.
  • Tweak: Links in the popup open in a new tab, so the popup is still there when visitors come back.
  • Tweak: The live preview shows links as you type.
  • Tweak: When the popup opens, keyboard focus goes to the first button instead of a link.
  • Security: Popup texts allow only links and simple formatting (bold, italic, line breaks); everything else is removed on save and on display.

1.3.0

  • New: Redesigned settings screen with sidebar navigation, live desktop / mobile preview and a sticky save bar.
  • New: Setup wizard that opens after the first activation (also available from the settings header).
  • New: Date-of-birth check with separate Day / Month / Year fields in the visitor’s own order and language. The calendar library was removed, making the plugin much lighter.
  • New: “Both” verification method (Yes / No buttons with a date-of-birth option).
  • New: Test mode and an administrator preview link.
  • New: Five ready-made colour styles.
  • New: Choose one of your own pages as the under-age page.
  • New: Pages without the popup (settings screen and an “Age verification” box in the editor).
  • New: Verification counter on the General tab (daily totals only, stored on your site, can be turned off).
  • New: “Age verification this week” dashboard widget.
  • New: One-click “Sorry, come back later” page for under-age visitors.
  • New: Free vs Pro comparison page.
  • Fix: The popup no longer appears on the under-age page itself.
  • Tweak: Larger, easier-to-read settings screen and live preview.
  • New: Accessible popup dialog (focus handling, keyboard support and screen reader labels).
  • Security: All settings are validated and sanitized on save (verification method, ages, URLs and colours).
  • Fix: Apostrophes in popup texts no longer get extra backslashes after saving.
  • Fix: Special characters such as “&” in the popup texts are shown correctly.
  • Fix: The “Remember me” label now shows the cookie duration you set.
  • Fix: If a verification method from the Pro version is stored, the free popup now falls back to the date-of-birth check instead of showing no buttons.
  • Tweak: The verification cookie now uses the SameSite and Secure flags.
  • Tweak: Removed external font loading and stopped hiding other plugins’ notices.
  • Tweak: Deleting the plugin removes its settings, except when the Pro version is installed.

1.2.0

  • Major UX Update: Overhauled the admin sidebar with a modern SaaS layout, featuring a dedicated support widget and dynamic cross-sell grid.
  • UX Enhancement: Added a sticky “Save Changes” action button to the top header for faster workflow navigation.
  • Tweak: Restricted plugin admin notices strictly to the plugin’s own settings page to prevent dashboard clutter.

1.1.9

  • Major UI Update: Overhauled the admin dashboard with a modern, responsive full-width layout.

1.1.8

  • Tweak: Allowed the Pro version to run as a standalone plugin.

1.1.7

  • New Feature: AJAX settings saving with toast notifications.

1.1.6

  • Fix: Full cache compatibility by moving the cookie check to the browser.
  • New: WPML and Polylang support.

1.1.5

  • Tweak: Better mobile scrolling inside the popup.

1.1.4

  • Fix: Date-of-birth field layout on iOS.

1.1.3

  • New: Settings and upgrade links on the Plugins screen.

1.1.2

  • Fix: Popup re-appearing on cached pages.

1.1.1

  • Tweak: Review request widget in the settings sidebar.

1.1.0

  • New: Redesigned popup, minimum age, SEO crawler bypass, logged-in bypass, “Remember me”, colour pickers, logo upload and settings tabs.

1.0.1

  • Compatibility update for WordPress 7.0.

1.0

  • Initial release.
